listing.name: Top Gear (SNES) (Top Gear for Windows)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Windows/Linux package; partial native conversion Limits: Partial native conversion: translated races, emulated menus/routines. Linux experimentally untested on real machines. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP and experimental Linux x86-64 tar.gz. Linux build untested on real machines upstream; native races retain emulated menus/routines. Original data: Own unmodified Top Gear USA SNES ROM, 524,288 bytes after optional 512-byte copier-header removal, SHA-256 ca9889f17f184b3d99a2eaaa82af73e366f03ed00313fdd369e5e023b208e788. Select it in topgear-launcher or supply it beside/topgear executable; original graphics/audio remain read from that ROM. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
